card.name: Words leading into a scenic view
card.fires_on: Small linking words and verbs just before or after "view" in travel or place descriptions, such as "take in the view", "view of" and "view across". It also fires on lookout phrases like "From here,".

modes.label: Before a view is named
modes.description: Verbs and small words that lead into a description of what can be seen from a spot.
modes.example: have a seat and take<< in>> the view.

modes.label: After the word view
modes.description: Prepositions right after "view" that introduce the scenery seen.
modes.example: There is a scenic view<< over>> the bay toward the peninsula

modes.label: Looking from a vantage point
modes.description: Words in phrases about looking out or seeing a landmark from a place.
modes.example: Standing in the doorway and<< looking>> outward, one faces, across the urban

card.writes: It pushes toward words about sight and distant views, such as sight, viewing and far away.
card.plain: It marks travel-writing phrases that are about to describe the view from a spot.
